long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Dusk is when the telescope leaves something worth keeping, and I mean to look at the moon's colour myself.
Dusk restlessness needs somewhere to go, and this patch near the telescope will do.
Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I will read about them.
The moon has still not settled its colour, so I will try to draw it again.
The telescope is mine, and the claim should be on record.
The lamp on my desk is mine, and I photographed it once already, but a second picture in the dusk light will do.

today.reason: The earlier plan had a photograph step with no target, so I have rebuilt the evening around the telescope, the desk and the bookshelf.
